note: Media Slideshow has no .module file: it is config plus one service. config/install (dependencies enforced) ships block_content.type.media_slideshow (label 'Slideshow', revision false), field.storage.block_content.field_slideshow_items (entity_reference to media, cardinality -1), the required field instance labelled 'Media items' with target_bundles null, core.entity_view_mode.media.slideshow, a default form display and a default view display rendering the field with the slick_entityreference_vanilla formatter. The single service lightning_media_slideshow.uninstall_validator (Drupal\lightning_media_slideshow\UninstallValidator, tagged module_install.uninstall_validator, lazy) blocks uninstall while any media_slideshow block content exists. lightning_media_slideshow_update_9001() downloads Slick 1.8.0 into /libraries/slick-carousel when no slick library is found. No routes, permissions, settings form (configure = null), config schema, Drush or plugin types.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal module lightning_media_slideshow actually add to a site - which entity type and bundle, which field, and which formatter renders it?
evals.expected_output: A custom block type block_content.type.media_slideshow labelled 'Slideshow' with one required, unlimited-cardinality entity reference field field_slideshow_items targeting media entities. Its default view display renders that field with the slick_entityreference_vanilla formatter (optionset default, skin default). It also adds a media.slideshow view mode.

evals.prompt: Uninstalling lightning_media_slideshow on a Drupal site fails with a message about deleting blocks first. What is enforcing that, and how do I actually uninstall the module?
evals.expected_output: The service lightning_media_slideshow.uninstall_validator (Drupal\lightning_media_slideshow\UninstallValidator, tagged module_install.uninstall_validator) counts block_content entities of type media_slideshow and returns the problem 'To uninstall Media Slideshow, you must delete all slideshow blocks first.' Delete every media_slideshow block content entity, then uninstall - the block type and field are removed with the module because their dependencies are enforced.

evals.prompt: lightning_media_slideshow renders its carousel with Slick. Which contrib module supplies the formatter, and what does the module's update hook do about the JavaScript library?
evals.expected_output: The formatter comes from slick_entityreference (a declared dependency alongside block_content and lightning_media). lightning_media_slideshow_update_9001() checks for a slick, slick-carousel or accessible-slick library and, if none is found, downloads Slick 1.8.0 into <docroot>/libraries/slick-carousel.

evals.prompt: A custom block type on this Drupal site is labelled 'LM Carousel'. Inspect the running site and tell me its machine name, and the machine name of the field on it that references media items.
evals.expected_output: The block type's machine name is media_slideshow and its media reference field is field_slideshow_items (an entity_reference field targeting media entities).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, how many media items can an editor put into a single Slideshow block? Inspect the live field configuration and tell me where that limit is stored.
evals.expected_output: Seven. field.storage.block_content.field_slideshow_items currently has cardinality 7 (the module ships -1, i.e. unlimited), and cardinality lives on the field storage, not the field instance.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, tighten up the Slideshow block type provided by lightning_media_slideshow: a slideshow must hold at most 6 media items, and editors must only be able to pick Image or Document media items for it. Apply both changes to the live site.
evals.expected_output: field.storage.block_content.field_slideshow_items cardinality is 6, and field.field.block_content.media_slideshow.field_slideshow_items has handler_settings.target_bundles containing exactly image and document.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site already has two Document media items named 'LM Slide A' and 'LM Slide B'. Using the block type that lightning_media_slideshow provides, create a slideshow block whose description/label is 'LM Slideshow Task' and which references both of those media items.
evals.expected_output: A block_content entity of type media_slideshow with info 'LM Slideshow Task' whose field_slideshow_items references the media IDs of both 'LM Slide A' and 'LM Slide B'.
